title: Fall $$2024$$ Final
body: Selected questions from the Fall $$2024$$ Final. Q3 (parts g, $$h$$, j) concerns models predicting $$\text{self\_rating}$$ using data from $$\text{skate\_record}$$ (columns $$\text{critic\_1}$$, $$\text{critic\_2}$$, $$\text{self\_rating}$$); $$parts$$ $$(g)$$, $$(h)$$, $$and$$ $$(j)$$ $$are$$ $$independent$$. $$Q4$$ $$concerns$$ $$models$$ $$predicting$$ $$\text{attendance\_rate}$$ from $$\text{discussions}$$. $$We$$ $$have$$ $$\text{discussions}$$, $$a$$ $$DataFrame$$ $$where$$ $$each$$ $$row$$ $$describes$$ $$one$$ $$discussion$$ $$section$$, $$with$$ $$columns$$ $$\text{dist\_from\_bell}$$ (distance in meters to the Campanile), $$\text{section\_no}$$ (the week, from $$1$$ to 13), $$\text{weather}$$ (sunny, cloudy, or rainy), and $$\text{attendance\_rate}$$ (between $$0$$ and 1).
